P1.evidence: A full load of /shop/cart throws 'Minified React error #418 (args[]=text)' on every run and at every width (p1sweep.json: cart1/cart2 @320/390/820/1440; p1flow.json hydrate_fast and hydrate_slow). The cause: shop/cart.html was exported on 2026-09-25, and cart/page.tsx:360,375 calls minDueDate()/maxDueDate() while it renders. The exported text therefore reads 'the earliest we can have it ready is Saturday 26 September', which is before today (2026-09-29). Because getServerSnapshot is EMPTY, the page before hydration shows the whole cart layout with 'Subtotal (0 cakes) $0.00', 'Pay deposit $0.00', no cake row, and a header pill reading 'Order Now -> /shop'. The calendar has Sat 26, Sun 27, Mon 28 and Tue 29 September enabled, all in the past or today (ui-audit-P1-cart-prehydration-390.png, JS off). With a 4x CPU / 1.6 Mbps / 150 ms profile, DOMContentLoaded lands at 2.5s and hydration at 6.0s, so the customer looks at $0.00 for about 3.5s (ui-audit-P1-cart-before-hydration-slow-390.png). Stale disabled attributes do NOT survive: after #418 React re-renders on the client, and 24–29 Sep are :off with only 30 Sep :ON (days_after in p1flow.json). With an empty cart, the page shows 'Your order' + $0.00 before it flips to 'No cakes yet' (ui-audit-P1-cart-empty-prehydration-390.png). Every static-page cart pill links to /shop/cart as a full load (promo.js:283), so every static-to-cart entry takes this path. The in-app Link navigation from the product page does not throw.
P1.fix: In shop-app/app/cart/page.tsx, render nothing date- or cart-dependent until `loaded` is true: `if (!loaded) return <><ShopHeader/><main …>{/* quiet skeleton: title + steps only */}</main></>`. Alternative at the same size: compute `const min = loaded ? minDueDate() : ''` and render the 'earliest we can' line only when loaded.
